name: reject unknown top-level field
policy_yaml:
version: 1
defaults:
  decision: deny
bossmode: true

name: reject unknown operation typo
policy_yaml:
version: 1
defaults:
  decision: deny
environments:
  production:
    databases:
      main:
        allow:
          - operations: [selct]

name: reject unknown rule field
policy_yaml:
version: 1
defaults:
  decision: deny
environments:
  production:
    databases:
      main:
        allow:
          - operations: [select]
            ownertable: [t]

name: reject bad sensitive action
policy_yaml:
version: 1
defaults:
  decision: deny
environments:
  production:
    databases:
      main:
        sensitive:
          columns: [a.b]
          action: mask

name: reject bad mutation name
policy_yaml:
version: 1
defaults:
  decision: deny
environments:
  production:
    databases:
      main:
        mutations:
          deny_without_where: [drop]

name: reject legacy bool word as boolean
policy_yaml:
version: 1
defaults:
  decision: deny
  require_limit: yes

name: reject legacy on word as boolean
policy_yaml:
version: 1
defaults:
  decision: deny
  require_limit: ON

name: accept full demo policy
policy_yaml:
version: 1
defaults:
  decision: deny
  on_parse_error: deny
  on_unknown: deny
  require_limit: false
  max_limit: 1000
environments:
  production:
    databases:
      main:
        allow:
          - operations: [select]
        deny:
          - operations: [drop]
        approval_required:
          - operations: [delete]
        sensitive:
          columns: ["*.api_key"]
          action: deny
        mutations:
          deny_without_where: [update, delete]
        row_safety:
          require_limit: false
          max_limit: 1000
tests:
  - name: x
    sql: SELECT 1
    expect: deny
